scripts.build: npm run build:broker && npm run studio:build
scripts.studio:build: npm run build:pipeline && npm run build --workspace @video-factory/studio
scripts.studio:dev: npm run build:pipeline && npm run dev --workspace @video-factory/studio
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/workflow-core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/production-pipeline/tsconfig.json && npm run build:pipeline && npm run typecheck --workspace @video-factory/studio && npm run typecheck:broker
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:ts && npm run test:broker && npm run studio:test && npm run build && npm run test:package
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:core && VIDEO_FACTORY_E2E=1 node --test --import tsx packages/production-pipeline/test/e2e.real.test.ts
scripts.test:ts: npm run build:core && node --test --import tsx packages/*/test/*.test.ts
